reference.description: Your own id for the user, from a secret-key proposal. Null otherwise.

revoked_at.description: Never set on a connection you can read.

status.description: Always active from your side. A revoked connection answers 403 connection_revoked before you can read it.

amount.description: What lands, in the Balance asset's smallest unit.
The most authoritative figure known, in the asset's smallest unit: settled, else detected, else the pinned outbound amount.

asset.description: CAIP-19 id of the asset credited.

balance_id.description: The root Balance the deposit credits.

credited_at.description: When the ledger entry was posted, or null.

display_amount.description: amount as a decimal string, for display only.

partner_detected_at.description: When the partner saw the inbound transfer, or null.

received_via.description: The instruction the funds arrived through, when one was published.

deposit_id.description: The deposit the credit posts under.

display_fee_amount.description: fee_amount as a decimal string, for display only.

display_gross_total.description: gross_total as a decimal string, for display only.

display_net_amount.description: net_amount as a decimal string, for display only.

fee_amount.description: Final's fee, taken from what landed.

gross_total.description: What landed, before the fee, in the asset's smallest unit.

after_cursor.description: Send it as after_cursor for the next page.

display_waiting_total.description: waiting_total as a decimal string, for display only.

fee_basis_points.description: Final's fee on each landing, in basis points.

fiat_currency.description: The unit the fiat figures are in.

minimum_fiat.description: The floor a group must reach to credit, in fiat_currency's smallest unit.

waiting_total.description: What is waiting to credit, in the asset's smallest unit.

waiting_total_fiat.description: The same, in fiat_currency's smallest unit.

balance_id.description: Present only when the window is on your Balance.

closed_at.description: When it was closed early, when it was.

id.description: Present only when the window is on your Balance.

opened_by_caller.description: Whether your own connection opened it.

ends_at.description: An hour from now by default, at most 24 hours out.

replace_active.description: Close a window your own connection holds and open this one in its place.

amount.description: What landed, in the asset's smallest unit.

balance_id.description: The Balance it routed to, or null while unrouted.

batch.description: Present once the fee pull has started.

block_time.description: When the chain recorded it, when known.

chain.description: CAIP-2 id of the chain it landed on.

display_amount.description: amount as a decimal string, for display only.

livemode.description: Whether this is a live-mode landing.

waiting_reason.description: Why it has not credited. Absent when nothing is in the way.

address.description: The address landings in this asset arrive on.

default_balance_id.description: The account's default for this asset, or null when unset or not yours.

is_default.description: Whether this Balance is the default.

routed_by.description: The rule a landing arriving now would route by.

base.description: CAIP-19 id of the held asset.

rate.description: Quote units per one base unit, as a decimal string. Compute against this.

detail.description: On user-present gates: an object with url, where to send the user.

param.description: The field at fault, when one is.

request_id.description: Always present. Echoes a client X-Request-ID; quote it to support.

assets.description: 1 to 8 CAIP-19 ids. One root Balance each.

code_challenge.description: base64url(sha256(code_verifier)). Required on a publishable key.

direct_deposit.description: Ask to route the user's own deposits to your Balances.

redirect_uri.description: Must exactly equal a registered redirect. Omitting it falls back to the primary.

reference.description: Your own id for the user, up to 256 printable characters. Secret key only.

id.description: The connection id you will activate or address.

after_cursor.description: Send it as after_cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

approval_url.description: Open it top level as it is. It does not expire.

approved_at.description: When the user approved, or null.

connection.description: The connection this proposal became. Present on the single read and on events, never on the list.

result_resource.description: The connection the approval created, once completed.

type.description: At most max per calendar period.
At most max to one recipient.

id.description: The merchant name as the issuer reports it.

type.description: At most max in any window of this length.

window.description: ISO 8601 duration, such as P1D or PT1H.

amount.description: The cap, in that asset's smallest unit.

asset.description: iso4217:USD, or the Balance's own asset.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque secret; resolved by prefix to a session token or API key.
